# The Count of Krigsvold

> The Count of Krigsvold puts an Antarctic title to work through polar education, research support, and evidence-led advocacy focused on Antarctica and its global consequences.

Website: https://krigsvold.org/
Site operator: James P. Howard, II

## Main content

- [About](https://krigsvold.org/about/): purpose and background of the project.
- [What is Krigsvold?](https://krigsvold.org/what-is-krigsvold/): the title, the Krigsvold Nunataks, and the project's framing.
- [Antarctica](https://krigsvold.org/antarctica/): geographic and environmental context.
- [Research Support](https://krigsvold.org/research-support/): support for research and related activity.
- [Fellowship](https://krigsvold.org/fellowship/): the Count of Krigsvold Fellowship in Environmental Policy.
- [Fellows](https://krigsvold.org/fellows/): fellowship recipients and related records.
- [Advocacy](https://krigsvold.org/advocacy/): evidence-led public positions and educational work.
- [Positions](https://krigsvold.org/positions/): formal position statements with sourcing.
- [Mission and Method](https://krigsvold.org/mission-and-method/): how the project selects, sources, and presents work.
- [Sources and Method](https://krigsvold.org/sources-and-method/): sourcing, corrections, and evidentiary standards.
- [Corrections](https://krigsvold.org/corrections/): material corrections and changes.

## Interpretation notes

The Count of Krigsvold is a Westarctican title associated with the Krigsvold Nunataks in Marie Byrd Land. It does not confer ownership, jurisdiction, sovereignty, or governmental authority over Antarctic territory. Scientific and policy claims should be read with the cited sources and correction record.
